statements: CREATE TABLE customer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_number TEXT, email TEXT, region TEXT)
CREATE TABLE dealer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, dealer_code TEXT, channel TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sales_order (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customer(id), dealer_id INTEGER REFERENCES dealer(id), order_date TEXT, amount REAL, promised_days INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE shipment (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER REFERENCES sales_order(id), shipped_date TEXT, delivery_days INTEGER, status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE invoice (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER REFERENCES sales_order(id), invoice_date TEXT, amount REAL, paid_days INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE supplier (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_code TEXT, country TEXT, risk_tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE work_order (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id INTEGER REFERENCES supplier(id), machine_code TEXT, planned_cost REAL, actual_cost REAL, cycle_minutes REAL)
CREATE TABLE quality_check (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, work_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES work_order(id), defect_count INTEGER, sample_size INTEGER, result TEXT)
CREATE TABLE machine_event (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, work_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES work_order(id), event_code TEXT, downtime_minutes REAL)

CREATE TABLE acct_dim (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, external_code TEXT, territory TEXT)
CREATE TABLE route_dim (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, route_code TEXT, route_family TEXT)
CREATE TABLE txn_hdr (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, acct_id INTEGER REFERENCES acct_dim(id), route_id INTEGER REFERENCES route_dim(id), booked_on TEXT, net_value REAL)
CREATE TABLE fulfil_evt (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, txn_id INTEGER REFERENCES txn_hdr(id), elapsed_days INTEGER, state TEXT)
CREATE TABLE bill_doc (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, txn_id INTEGER REFERENCES txn_hdr(id), billed_value REAL, settlement_days INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE patient (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cohort_code TEXT, district TEXT)
CREATE TABLE encounter (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INTEGER REFERENCES patient(id), admitted_on TEXT, length_days INTEGER, disposition TEXT)
CREATE TABLE lab_result (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, encounter_id INTEGER REFERENCES encounter(id), test_code TEXT, numeric_value REAL, unit TEXT)

CREATE TABLE opaque_b (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, opaque_a_id INTEGER REFERENCES opaque_a(id), state_y TEXT)
